label: prf:mobius-energy-frobenius-kernel
title: Proof of the classical limit of the Frobenius--Hopf kernel
html:
Proof. At q = 1 the q-Hodge star reduces to the classical Hodge star, and the comultiplication \Delta becomes cocommutative. The Frobenius pairing \int_A \circ \mu on A \otimes A reduces to the standard \mathrm{SU}(2) Killing form, so the integrand simplifies to

  \mathrm{tr}\bigl(
    \Delta(\gamma(s)) \otimes \Delta(\gamma(t))
  \bigr)
  \xrightarrow{q \to 1}
  \frac{1}{\lvert \gamma(s) - \gamma(t) \rvert^2}.

The repulsive kernel 1/r^2 is thus the classical shadow of the resistance of the Frobenius--Hopf object A to local deformations of the connection \nabla: the Frobenius form \int_A assigns a diverging cost when two strands of \gamma approach. \square
